process_type: Atomic Layer Epitaxy with Limited Reaction Processing (ALELRP)
temperature_range: 150 to 175 °C for cadmium deposition, 300 to 320 °C for tellurium deposition
summary: The study demonstrates the growth of cadmium telluride using diisopropyl telluride and dimethyl cadmium through a modified atomic layer epitaxy technique that allows independent temperature control for each deposition cycle. This approach overcomes the limitations of isothermal ALD by using non-overlapping temperature processing windows for the two reactants.
evidence: Layer-by-layer, self-limited growth is demonstrated using the new growth technique, using temperature ranges of 150 to 175 °C and 300 to 320 °C for the cadmium and tellurium deposition cycles, respectively.
